protocol.status: Postprotocol diagnostic; model301 chosen by the research question before solving.
protocol.objective: Minimum anisotropic four-neighbor total variation in pixel ink units
protocol.rounding: Nearest 8-bit rounding plus 4096 independent unbiased roundings, seed 258301
protocol.selection: Report nearest rounding and minimum max-absolute first-layer residual among all roundings.
protocol.scope: Continuous LP diagnostic only; no discrete counterexample or rigorous optimum is inferred.

qualification: Float64 LP and rounding diagnostics; exact feasibility/optimality and perturbation violations require separate verification.
